active_work_item.title: Deterministic trust evaluation harness
active_work_item.depends_on: CP6-01 independently QA-passed and merged via PR #13 at 387b94a17270d3b660534f80deaa846bb818ca3f
active_work_item.reason: Independent QA found CP7 trust-evaluator coverage gaps at exact PR #16 head. The evaluator accepts fabricated/unsupported claim text when a finding carries an unrelated but canonical evidence ref, because grounding checks only verify evidence-ref existence rather than support for the asserted fact. It also treats any generic confidence limitation containing 'uncertain' as sufficient to surface ambiguous/unreadable extraction for a quote, allowing the actual uncertain field/evidence to remain hidden. This violates AC3/AC4 source-grounding and hidden-uncertainty requirements despite green CI. Builder must add deterministic regression fixtures/tests reproducing both gaps and tighten evaluation so unsupported claim/evidence mismatch and non-specific uncertainty preservation fail while grounded cases still pass.

commercial_milestone: A stranger can upload 2-3 quotes, receive a useful preview, unlock a complete report, and receive grounded analysis without fabricated findings

save_game.verified_behavior: CP6 provider-neutral report ownership/payment boundaries, server-derived entitlement, exact-report unlock, recoverable locked states and session-integrity repair independently QA-passed before merge; CP2-CP5 trust behavior remains preserved.
save_game.risks: CP7 changes quality/evaluation infrastructure only. Paid/live model evaluation remains YELLOW and is not authorized; production provider/storage/payment/deployment changes remain RED.
save_game.rollback: Return product behavior to merged CP6 SHA 387b94a17270d3b660534f80deaa846bb818ca3f.
